title: What courses do you offer?
content: We offer a variety of courses designed to enhance your skills in software development, UI/UX design, and cloud technologies.

title: How much do courses and mentorship sessions cost?
content: Our courses and mentorship sessions are designed to offer high value at an affordable cost, ensuring you get the best return on your investment in learning and career growth.

title: What is the duration of the courses?
content: Courses typically range from 4 to 12 weeks, depending on the program and your learning pace.

title: Do I need prior experience to enroll?
content: No prior experience is required for most of our courses. We welcome learners at all levels.

title: What platforms do you use for training?
content: We utilize a mix of online platforms, including Zoom for live sessions and GitHub for project collaboration.

title: Will I receive a certificate upon completion?
content: Yes, you will receive a certificate upon successful completion of the course, which can be shared on your LinkedIn profile.

title: Is this platform suitable for beginners?
content: Absolutely! Our programs are designed for learners of all levels, including beginners looking to start their tech journey.

title: How do mentorship sessions work?
content: Mentorship sessions are conducted in small batches by industry experts, focusing on practical learning. We also provide dedicated doubt-solving support to ensure you stay on track with your progress.

title: What if I miss a live session?
content: All live sessions are recorded and made available for later viewing, so you can catch up at your convenience.

title: Is there a community for learners?
content: Yes, we have an active community where learners can connect, share knowledge, and collaborate on projects.

title: What is the job placement assistance?
content: We provide job placement assistance, including resume reviews, interview preparation, and access to job openings.

title: Can I switch courses after enrolling?
content: Yes, you can switch courses within the first week of enrollment if you find that another course better suits your needs.

title: How do I get started?
content: Simply sign up on our website, choose your desired course, and start your learning journey!
